verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm that an llms.txt exists at vercel.com/llms.txt and that the AI Gateway docs page is served as agent-readable markdown at /docs/ai-gateway.md, with structured frontmatter. An agent can therefore be pointed at either one directly. Missing for 10: a gateway-specific llms.txt (the file found is Vercel-wide) and first-party documentation or independent corroboration of the agent-oriented docs' coverage and depth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
